dct_description_sm: The Yellowknives Dene First Nation (YKDFN) have already been impacted by climate change. Dramatic declines in caribou herds, lower water levels on the Great Slave Lake, unsafe traditional travel routes, and permafrost degradation have all been influenced to a certain degree by climate change. The purpose of this project was to support the Yellowknives Dene to be better prepared for current and emerging concerns of future climate change.
